'''Davar Khoshnevisan''' (born 21 July 1964) is an American mathematician. 

== Biography ==
Khoshnevisan completed bachelor's and master's degrees in mathematical sciences at [[Johns Hopkins University]] and a doctorate at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], advised by Warry Millar.<ref name="utah">{{cite news |title=Davar Khoshnevisan |url=https://faculty.utah.edu/u0028393-DAVAR_KHOSHNEVISAN/hm/index.hml |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=University of Utah}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Davar Khoshnevisan |url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/people/davar-khoshnevisan |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=University of California, Berkeley}}</ref> Khoshnevisan began his teaching career at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]. After one year, he joined the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] faculty. In 1993, Khoshnevisan moved to the [[University of Utah]].<ref name="utah"/><ref name="mswaner">{{cite news |last1=Swaner |first1=Michele |title=U PROFESSOR AND CHAIR NAMED FELLOW OF AMERICAN MATHEMATICAL SOCIETY |url=https://science.utah.edu/faculty/fellow-of-the-ams/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=University of Utah |date=2019}}</ref> Khoshnevisan was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 2015,<ref>{{cite news |title=2015 IMS Fellows Announced |url=https://imstat.org/2015/05/20/2015-ims-fellows-announced/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics |date=20 May 2015}}</ref> and awarded an equivalent honor by the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2020.<ref name="mswaner"/>
